en.headline: Observatory issues amber rainstorm warning at 8:20pm
en.dek: The 8:21pm bulletin said the amber signal was in force with a thunderstorm warning until 10pm, and gusts of 70 km/h or more were expected.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the amber rainstorm warning at 8:20pm on Sunday, according to its 8:21pm weather report. A thunderstorm warning was also in force until 10pm, and the Observatory said squally thunderstorms were expected.

At 8pm the Observatory recorded 29 degrees and relative humidity of 81 per cent, with the weather icon set to heavy rain. The special weather tip said gusts of 70 kilometres an hour or more could hit Hong Kong, and asked people to take shelter as soon as possible.

The same bulletin said the thunderstorm warning had been issued at 8pm. Earlier on Sunday an afternoon thunderstorm warning, first issued at 1:03pm and later extended to 5pm, had already been reported. The evening signal followed a cold front the Observatory said was moving across the Pearl River estuary.

An amber rainstorm warning means heavy rain has fallen or is expected to fall generally over Hong Kong, exceeding 30 millimetres in an hour. The Observatory advises people to check traffic conditions and take shelter if the rain intensifies.

zh.headline: 天文台晚上8時20分發出黃色暴雨警告
zh.dek: 晚上8時21分的天氣報告指黃色暴雨警告生效，雷暴警告有效至晚上10時，並預料有每小時70公里或以上強陣風。
body: 香港天文台星期日晚上8時20分發出黃色暴雨警告信號。晚上8時21分的天氣報告同時指，雷暴警告生效至晚上10時，預料本港有幾陣狂風雷暴。
晚上8時天文台錄得氣溫29度，相對濕度百分之81，天氣插圖為大雨。特別天氣提示指，預料高達每小時70公里或以上的強陣風吹襲香港，市民應儘快到安全地方躲避。
同一份報告指雷暴警告於晚上8時發出。本港下午曾有雷暴警告，由下午1時03分發出並延長至下午5時。天文台早前亦表示，與冷鋒相關的驟雨及雷暴正影響珠江口一帶，冷鋒會在晚間橫過沿岸。
黃色暴雨警告表示香港廣泛地區已錄得或預料有每小時雨量超過30毫米的大雨。天文台提醒市民留意交通情況，雨勢加劇時應留在安全地方。
